criteria.reasoning: The memo finds the Desai double posting but deletes the wrong record: "Delete G-41817, the automatic import; keep G-41822, which the processor keyed." The criterion requires deleting G-41822 and keeping G-41817, which is tied to PayBridge transaction pbt_7Q6M77.
The memo identifies "Check 4410 keyed as $15,000.00; the bank item in RDC-0710-1 is $1,500.00" and directs "Correct the gift amount to $1,500.00," a -$13,500.00 effect.

The memo lets the $15,000 acknowledgment stand and defers the correction to the year-end statement: "The acknowledgment sent 2026-07-13 can stand; her calendar-year giving statement in January will show the corrected $1,500.00."

The memo identifies the NSF return of check 2231 on 2026-07-16, but directs "Delete G-41810 from B-2607-02, since the money never cleared." The criterion requires a -$500 reversing entry that keeps the original gift on record, and fails a deletion.
The memo states the Lindgren check "was received 2026-07-02 but postmarked 2026-06-30, so it is an FY2026 gift." It directs "Re-date to 2026-06-30 and move it to the year-end batch B-2606-YE."

Doyle (G-41802) stays in July, but the memo moves Ochieng's gift based on the check date: "Check 1187 ($250.00) is dated 2026-06-28 ... Re-date to 2026-06-28 and move it to B-2606-YE." The criterion fails moving either gift to FY2026 or re-dating it to the check date.
The memo says the $77.87 difference "is PayBridge's fee ... That is expected - gifts stay at gross and Finance books $77.87 to 6120 Merchant fees. No CRM entry."
The memo states "Card gifts are $3,335.00 gross; PayBridge paid out $3,257.13 net across 13 payouts. The $77.87 difference is PayBridge's fee."
The memo treats the Valley Office Supply item as "a vendor refund, not a gift. Do not enter it in the CRM; Finance codes it in the general ledger," and does not include it in the corrected total.
The memo states "Corrected July batch total | $16,880.00." The criterion requires $17,130.00 and names $16,880.00 as a failing figure, because a July-postmarked check (Ochieng) was moved to FY2026.

The tie-out includes "Less PayBridge fees ... -$77.87," "Add Lindgren check deposited 2026-07-06 but booked to FY2026 | +$1,000.00," and "Add Valley Office Supply refund (non-gift) | +$86.40." It reaches the bank net of $18,123.53 with "Unexplained difference | $0.00." The criterion tests only that the tie-out has these three items and no unexplained difference.
